name: Tanchjim
description: Tanchjim is the "Apple of Chi-Fi" when it comes to clean, minimalist industrial design. They favor pristine medical-grade white resins, sandblasted aerospace alloys, and crystal-clear presentation. Acoustically, Tanchjim is famous for target-curve accuracy, emphasizing hyper-clean, reference-grade neutrality, pristine female vocal clarity, and immaculate treble extension without introducing harsh sibilance.
